__NOTOC__
==Usage==
<code><nowiki>{{DItop-arc|</nowiki>{{Var|date}}<nowiki>}}</nowiki></code>

For use as a header on [[Forum:Discussions index archive|Discussions index archive]] pages. The <code>{{Var|date}}</code> parameter is used for categorization.

===Required parameters===
#{{Para||{{Var|date}}}} The earliest date of the archive page's content, in <code>YYYY</code> format if the page archives forum data from a specific year, <code>YYYY-MM</code> format if the page archives forum data from a specific month or months, or <code>YYYY-MM-DD</code> format if the page archives forum data from a specific day or days.

==Examples==
{| class="wikitable"
! Page
! Code
|-
| [[Forum:Discussions index archive 2020]]
| <pre style="background:none; border:none">{{DItop-arc|2020}}</pre>
|-
| [[Forum:Discussions index archive 2020/February]]
| <pre style="background:none; border:none">{{DItop-arc|2020-02}}</pre>
|-
| [[Forum:Discussions index archive 2020/May 1–16]]
| <pre style="background:none; border:none">{{DItop-arc|2020-05-01}}</pre>
|}
